scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@pokedex/backend && npm run build --workspace=@pokedex/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@pokedex/backend && npm run lint --workspace=@pokedex/frontend && npm run typecheck
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:fuzz
scripts.governance:audit-scripts: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const allowed=['scripts/dr_verify_restore.sh']; const findSh=(dir)=>{ let r=[]; for(const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)){ const p=path.join(dir,f); if(['node_modules','.git','dist','coverage','.turbo'].includes(f)) continue; if(fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) r=r.concat(findSh(p)); else if(f.endsWith('.sh')) r.push(p.replace(/\\/g,'/')); } return r; }; const found=findSh('.'); const unauth=found.filter(s=>!allowed.some(a=>s.endsWith(a))); if(unauth.length>0){ console.error('❌ Scripts no autorizados detectados:', unauth); process.exit(1); } console.log('✔ Gobernanza de scripts validada: solo scripts autorizados presentes:', allowed);"
